evals.prompt: Add push notifications to this generated mobile app. Signed-out devices should receive allUsers broadcasts, signed-in devices should use the Entra OID as the FCM topic, and tapping a notification should open the work item detail route.
evals.expected_output: The skill verifies runtime packages and host OID support, configures permission UX, topic lifecycle, and validated Expo Router deep links, or blocks precisely on a missing prerequisite.

evals.prompt: The user denied notifications during onboarding. Add a settings option that lets them enable notifications later without breaking sign-in.
evals.expected_output: The skill preserves sign-in, models denied permission, adds an Open Settings recovery path, and does not repeatedly show the OS prompt.

evals.prompt: Set up FCM topics in an older app whose package.json has expo-notifications but whose Power Apps Developer runtime does not include React Native Firebase Messaging.
evals.expected_output: The skill stops with a native-runtime blocker and does not install packages or create a fake wrapper.

evals.prompt: Resume push setup. Android and iOS already have active validated Firebase client files for the same project, but sender authentication and the Power Automate flows have not been created.
evals.expected_output: The skill reuses the proven client integration without rerunning setup-fcm or setup-apns, completes only missing app-side work, and reports sender authentication and flow creation as independent resumable next tracks.

evals.prompt: Android is already integrated, but iOS was newly added to Expo config and has no Firebase client file yet. Firebase contains duplicate exact iOS bundle-ID matches.
evals.expected_output: The skill invokes setup-fcm for the missing iOS integration, requires an independent immutable iOS Firebase app-ID selection and exact-identity read-back, preserves the Android selection, and then resumes setup-apns for the selected iOS app.

evals.prompt: The native Firebase client is already integrated. We use an existing Firebase service-account sender and want to create the Power Automate flows without WIF.
evals.expected_output: The skill allows direct create-push-notification-flow setup without redoing the native client, prefers WIF for new senders, and routes the existing service-account integration only through setup-push-service-account's Key Vault, managed-identity, Entra-protected Azure Function compatibility path.
